node.statement: With node 1.1 as an explicit dependency, put a:=e_cross^0>0, b:=e_env^0>0, K0:=K_3^0=max{1,a/b}, K:=W.K3, E:=W.e_cross, and x:=epsilon. Then K0>=1 and K0>=a/b, so K0>0 and, multiplying K0>=a/b by b/K0>0, a/K0<=b. The root hypotheses give K>=max{K0,1,W.L,W.c0_cb*W.L}, E<=a, and 0<=x<=E/K. Thus K>=1, hence K>0; from 0<=x<=E/K it follows that E>=0. Multiplication by K gives 0<=K*x=t_3<=E<=a, and (K-1)*x>=0 gives x<=K*x=t_3. Finally K>=K0>0 and 0<=E<=a imply x<=E/K<=a/K<=a/K0<=b. Therefore 0<=epsilon<=e_env^0 and 0<=epsilon<=t_3<=W.e_cross<=e_cross^0.
